data.one_liner: A simple utility for creating Graphviz directed graphs using an object oriented API.
data.what_it_does: Provides an object-oriented API for writing Graphviz dot files. Allows users to add nodes, edges, and graph properties to generate directed or undirected graphs.
use_when: You need to generate Graphviz dot files programmatically.
You want a simple API to build text-based graph representations.
avoid_when: You need to render graphs visually directly inside a Flutter widget tree.
You require complex graph algorithms and a fully-featured graph data structure library.
strengths: Supports both directed and undirected graphs.
weaknesses: Complex graph API features were removed in v0.3.0.
Only generates text dot files rather than rendering them.
